records.subject: All-in-one wearable patch
records.quote: Here, this study presents an all-in-one wearable patch that integrates a dual-functional self-powered thermogalvanic hydrogel with a selective electrochemical interface for intuitive visual feedback, dynamic temperature tracking, and durable sweat analysis.

records.subject: All-in-one wearable patch
records.quote: Here, this study presents an all-in-one wearable patch that integrates a dual-functional self-powered thermogalvanic hydrogel with a selective electrochemical interface for intuitive visual feedback, dynamic temperature tracking, and durable sweat analysis.
context_quotes: The hydrogel enables real-time thermochromic visualization and active thermoelectric sensing of body temperature, while an integrated electrochemical module allows continuous and selective detection of Na+ and K+ ions in sweat.
